wp433 N: dong bon no tren duong ghi credential cua tl_gws.py

Dac ta GWS-CRED-DICH-NGOAI-KHO-N r1 (sha256 fa48e076...), lease wp433-r6-g1-claude.

- M1 fragment packet 1: hai phep so cua N8.4-W2/N8.4-W6 so sau normcase(normpath) hai ve
  (W2: startswith ban chuan hoa cong os.sep; W6: bang nhau). Tren nt expanduser giu dau "/"
  nen phep so chuoi cu luon sai va os.replace khong bao gio nem.
- M2 them _chot_thu_muc: chi luat lien ket, moi tien to tu goc toi thu muc; khong kiem .git,
  khong tao/ghi. Goi sau dong chot W6 va cuoi _dich_jar_nlm (W1-W3). os.getcwd chi goi cho
  duong tuong doi; duong quy ve goc chi lstat goc (nt: sau khi do loai o).
- M3 bundle giai ma khong phai dict: bootstrap va nlm-auth-pull tra 3, mot dong stderr,
  truoc moi phep gan env / ghi tep / nhanh agent.
- M4 _trong_kho_git ba trang thai: chi FileNotFoundError/NotADirectoryError la "chua co";
  loi lstat khac lan ra.
- M5 fragment moi wp433_gws_cred_no: 3 ca, 27 luot, 5 dot bien (bang 4b), 3 tu kiem phan hang,
  phan chung bo do pc_doc_truoc.
- M6 bundled tai sinh bang generate_bundled_module_bytes; khong sua tay; khong dung manifest.

wp433 N r2: M7 - sua ky vong fragment C1 theo hanh vi M2/M4 tren Windows

Dac ta GWS-CRED-DICH-NGOAI-KHO-N r2 (sha256 72aaa5a4...), lease wp433-r6-g2-claude.
Do native tren head 143115a bat fragment C1 do o tich_hop_nt / W4.loai_o_loi: W6 nay cung
tu choi (fail-closed qua _chot_thu_muc) khi bo do loai o nem OSError, nen stderr co hai dong.

- (a) W4.loai_o_loi: doi hai dong "ghi loi: OSError" (W6 roi W4); them nhan w6 - khong
  "config OK" tren stdout va byte ~/.tra_luat_config.json khong doi so voi truoc luot.
- (b) W5.git_loi: bo tiem lstat chi nem o lan goi DAU vao <pk>/.git, vi sau M4
  _trong_kho_git cung lan loi o cung duong va che lop _co_git_nt (dot bien
  db_nt_git_nuot_loi song sot voi bo tiem moi-lan).
- bundled tai sinh bang generate_bundled_module_bytes; tl_gws.py khong doi.
